stem: Voltmarkt sells Business Care, a monthly device-support subscription for small offices. Its manager asks: "What share of the businesses subscribed at the start of September had cancelled by the end of September?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × the cohort's MRR at the end / its MRR at the start
100 × MRR lost to cancellations and downgrades / MRR at the start
100 × businesses that cancelled / businesses active at the start
September MRR / businesses active in September
